description: Header file defining the CTLogVerifier class for verifying Certificate Transparency logs, including methods for signature verification, signed tree head validation, and proof verification.

classes.name: CTLogVerifier
classes.description: A class for verifying signatures of a single Certificate Transparency log, including methods for verifying SCTs, signed tree heads, and Merkle proofs.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new CTLogVerifier instance with a public key and description.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies that a SignedCertificateTimestamp (SCT) is valid for a given entry.

methods.name: VerifySignedTreeHead
methods.description: Verifies that a Signed Tree Head (STH) is valid for this log.

methods.name: VerifyConsistencyProof
methods.description: Verifies a Merkle consistency proof between old and new tree hashes.

methods.name: VerifyAuditProof
methods.description: Verifies an audit proof that a leaf hash is included in the Merkle tree.
